title: Build Grokbot Like an Agency, Not a Chatbot
description:
We don’t let AI ship everything automatically.

Most of our bots can research, draft, and handle repetitive work, but there’s still a human checkpoint before anything goes out.

We also stopped trying to make one “super agent” do everything. Giving each bot one job makes the system easier to manage and the AI more focused.
